% Pattern: title/compound. A title of two item words joined by a hyphen or a
% slash, as "Lemma-Notation" or "Observation / Convention", is the item the
% first word names. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want lemnot-1 statement/lemma 1
% want obscon-1 statement/fact 2
% want propdef-1 statement/proposition 3
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{lemnot}{Lemma-Notation}
\newtheorem{obscon}[lemnot]{Observation / Convention}
\newtheorem{propdef}[lemnot]{Proposition-definition}
\begin{document}
\begin{lemnot}
Write $|x|$ for the norm of $x$; then $|x+y|\le|x|+|y|$.
\end{lemnot}
\begin{obscon}
Every set here is finite, and we take its size as its weight.
\end{obscon}
\begin{propdef}
The map $f$ is onto, and we call its fibre over $0$ the kernel.
\end{propdef}
\end{document}
